panels.title: Build duration p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Percentiles: p50 is the typical (median) value, half are faster and half slower. p95 means 95% finished within this time, only 5% were slower. p99 is nearly the worst case, only 1% were slower. If p50 is flat but p95/p99 rise, a few items are struggling. Estimated from histogram buckets, so precision depends on bucket size.

panels.title: Time since last message
panels.description: Large values with a connected broker can mean a quiet cluster or a stuck consumer.

panels.title: Message handling duration p95
panels.description: p95: 95% of messages were handled within this time.

panels.title: Messages published per minute
panels.description: Status and log messages sent back to Lagoon. result=error means the producer could not be obtained.

panels.title: Selection issues
panels.description: list_error, none_available (fell back to default host), all_busy (every host at its build limit).

panels.title: Running controllers
panels.description: Version and commit are populated when built with the VERSION and COMMIT docker build args.

panels.title: Single build (use the Project / Environment / Build filters)
Recent builds
panels.description: Finished builds still retained by the controller (about 1 hour after they end). Sort by duration to find slow builds.

targets.expr: max by (build_name, build_namespace, project, environment, build_type, dockerhost, outcome) (lagoon_build_total_duration_seconds{project=~"$project", environment=~"$environment", build_name=~"$build"})
max by (build_name, build_namespace, project, environment, build_type, dockerhost) (lagoon_build_end_timestamp_seconds{project=~"$project", environment=~"$environment", build_name=~"$build"}) * 1000

panels.title: Time in each step
panels.description: How long each selected build spent in each step. Select a single build to compare its steps.

panels.title: Running build duration
panels.description: Elapsed time of builds that are currently running.

targets.expr: (time() - max by (build_name, build_namespace, project, environment) (lagoon_build_start_timestamp_seconds{project=~"$project", environment=~"$environment", build_name=~"$build"})) unless on(build_name, build_namespace) lagoon_build_end_timestamp_seconds

panels.title: Finished build durations over time
panels.description: Total duration of each finished build, plotted at the time it was scraped.

targets.expr: max by (build_name, project, environment, outcome) (lagoon_build_total_duration_seconds{project=~"$project", environment=~"$environment", build_name=~"$build"})
